q1_issues.issue: The nightmoth group sk_nightmoth_1 is the subject of two distributive predicates (land, leave) but gets only the group event, with no per-member (Implication (PartOf $x sk_nightmoth_1) ...) distribution rule of the kind Quantifiers/Cardinality require for a grouped plural with a distributive predicate.

notes: The instruction set is itself in tension here: the bare-plural-episodic passage describes only a group witness acting in a normal event ("rescuers reached the ridge"), while Quantifiers/Cardinality say a grouped plural with a distributive predicate adds the per-member rule. Minor: sk_thread_1 is reused for the bare-plural re-mention "silken threads" in sentence 3, which is discourse-coherent but is strictly a fresh indefinite introduction.
